why: Restores a real latent crash that typing this module under checkJs surfaced (issue #417). GitHub OMITS the parent key rather than sending null when an issue has none, so `parentLoaded: true` with no `parent` sent `auditOpenIssues` into `nativeParent.number` and threw TypeError. The audit runs on every issues event, so one such payload took down the required check for every issue in the run -- a stack trace instead of a remediation. Measured on the pre-fix tree: it threw; after, it reports declared-parent-missing-native.
killedBy: native relationship contract treats an ABSENT native parent the same as a null one, instead of throwing (issue #417)
